caption: The drawing depicts a girl standing in profile, facing to the left. She is wearing a black bonnet with blue lining, tied under her chin with a bright blue ribbon. Her hair is blue and peeks out from under the bonnet. She wears a white shawl or capelet over her shoulders, on top of a long-sleeved shirt with a white background and small red floral patterns. Her dress consists of a blue and white plaid skirt as the outermost layer, with a reddish-pink overskirt decorated with small white floral shapes. Under these layers, there is another white petticoat with blue circular patterns and a bit of lace at the hem. She has black shoes with yellow detailing and a slight pointed toe. The background is a plain off-white or cream color with no additional objects or background details. The artist’s signature, "Edith Trowman," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll: "Mollie Bentley"
